scope: Exhaustive pinned operationId support classification, low-level error contract and explicit unsupported-operation policy.

error_contract.status_mapping: 401 AuthenticationError; 403 PermissionDeniedError; 429 RateLimitError; every other unexpected status, including 2xx/3xx, APIError.
error_contract.safe_failure: Malformed successful JSON raises ProtocolError; read disconnect raises TransportError.
error_contract.write_failure: Malformed successful JSON or disconnect after write headers raises RequestOutcomeUnknown.
error_contract.attempts: Exactly one HTTP attempt; redirects and aiohttp implicit idempotent connection retry are disabled.
error_contract.metadata: Bounded error_id/request_id/retry_after only; known credentials redacted; server prose omitted.
error_contract.unsupported: Unknown/unreviewed/ambiguous operationId is rejected before a session or network request exists.

regression_found.behavior: ClientSession retried an idempotent GET once after a server disconnect despite the SDK one-attempt contract.
regression_found.fix: Owned sessions explicitly disable aiohttp's connection retry; local HTTP regression counts one read and one write request.

native_stands.credential: ordinary bot token; no setup credential or administrative fallback

tests.per_version: 467 tests + 312 subtests, real Redis, zero skips
tests.quality: Ruff check/format passed for 172 files; strict mypy passed for 130 source files; replay/audit ready for 22 modules/30 decisions and 15 behavioral suites.

distributions.sdist_inputs: Coverage manifest and exhaustive report required and verified.
distributions.wheel_and_sdist_install: Each installed outside checkout: 79 unit + 79 integration + 1 Redis config + 16 real Redis + 28 provisioning tests.
